test_title: PYST 21: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 11 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Parts of the given sentence have been given as options. One of them contains a grammatical error. Select the option that has the error.**

I am deeply concerned about children all over the world who’ve had been orphaned due to the pandemic.
solution:
The correct answer is **'****who’ve had been**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The erroneous part of the sentence is **who’ve had been.**
 
• **Who've **is
